consequence.statement: A bug fix: waypoints can consume auto-allocated IPs without DNSProxy enabled; no operator action is stated.

original.statement: Waypoints no longer require DNSProxy to be enabled in order to consume auto-allocated IPs.

decision.reason: [ev-3cf1259609e1] describes only a bug fix: waypoints no longer need DNSProxy enabled to consume auto-allocated IPs. It does not say that anything fails, is rejected, stops being honoured or needs operator action, so no action-eligible kind is supported. The fix removes a constraint rather than changing a working default, so "none" (informational) fits the evidence better than behavior-change. It is low confidence because the note never says whether environments without DNSProxy will notice the new routing.
